name: Ada
wants: tin enough to finish the season's work
her daughter to learn the trade properly
contradiction: She is proud of work she considers invisible.

provenance.notes: An invented smith. Copper and bronze working on Cyprus is attested. A woman running a bronze workshop is unusual in the surviving evidence but not excluded; she is written as a plausible local case, and the art and dialogue agree that the smith is Ada, with her daughter sorting charcoal.
